response.title: Bab al-Amud in brief
response.summary: Bab al-Amud, also known as Damascus Gate, is the monumental northern entrance to the Old City and a major civic gathering place opening toward Khan al-Zeit.
response.narrative:
Bab al-Amud, also known as Damascus Gate, is the monumental northern entrance to the Old City and a major civic gathering place opening toward Khan al-Zeit.

A few facts:
- The current monumental façade is Ottoman, while the site includes earlier archaeological layers.
